verdict.rationale: HubSpot's own materials describe in-product AI that works on the user's CRM data. The CRM ships "with AI that makes it easy to understand" the data, Breeze Assistant builds reports from plain-language requests using actual data, and AI agents surface buy signals and suggest deal next steps and follow-up drafts. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of how AI insights and suggestions are generated and shown (only marketing pages are cited), and independent or hands-on corroboration that the insights work as claimed.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: HubSpot's free CRM unifies all your customer data on one platform, with AI that makes it easy to understand.
with Breeze Assistant, describe the report you need in plain language, and HubSpot will build it from your actual data.

Prospecting agent watches accounts for signals that they're ready to buy and reaches out automatically, while smart deal progression keeps deals moving after every call, with next steps handled for them.
Approve automatic CRM updates and follow-up drafts after every meeting
